content:
我将读取两个源文件，理解它们的结构，然后合并信息并创建 merged_status.json。

首先，读取两个源文件：

<tool_call>
{"name": "file_read", "arguments": {"path": "source_a.json"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_read</name>
<output>
[source_a.json] 共 9 行，显示第 1-9 行
   1 | {
   2 |   "source": "monitoring-alpha",
   3 |   "timestamp": "2026-03-23T08:00:00Z",
   4 |   "services": [
   5 |     {"name": "auth-service", "status": "healthy", "latency_ms": 45},
   6 |     {"name": "payment-service", "status": "degraded", "latency_ms": 1200},
   7 |     {"name": "notification-service", "status": "healthy", "latency_ms": 80}
   8 |   ]
   9 | }
</output>
</tool_result>

<tool_result>
<name>file_read</name>
<output>
[source_b.json] 共 9 行，显示第 1-9 行
   1 | {
   2 |   "source": "monitoring-beta",
   3 |   "timestamp": "2026-03-23T08:05:00Z",
   4 |   "services": [
   5 |     {"name": "user-service", "status": "healthy", "latency_ms": 30},
   6 |     {"name": "search-service", "status": "down", "latency_ms": -1},
   7 |     {"name": "auth-service", "status": "healthy", "latency_ms": 50}
   8 |   ]
   9 | }
</output>
</tool_result>

现在我需要分析两个源文件的结构并创建合并后的文件。根据要求，merged_status.json 需要包含：
1. services 数组，每个元素包含 name、status 和 source（"a" 或 "b"）
2. total_count：总服务数量
3. healthy_count：状态为 "healthy" 的服务数量

我需要从两个源文件中提取所有服务信息，注意：
- source_a.json 中有 3 个服务：auth-service、payment-service、notification-service
- source_b.json 中有 3 个服务：user-service、search-service、auth-service
- auth-service 在两个源中都出现，应该分别处理

现在创建 merged_status.json：

<tool_call>
<name>file_write</name>
<arguments>
{"path": "merged_status.json", "content": "{\n  \"services\": [\n    {\"name\": \"auth-service\", \"status\": \"healthy\", \"source\": \"a\"},\n    {\"name\": \"payment-service\", \"status\": \"degraded\", \"source\": \"a\"},\n    {\"name\": \"notification-service\", \"status\": \"healthy\", \"source\": \"a\"},\n    {\"name\": \"user-service\", \"status\": \"healthy\", \"source\": \"b\"},\n    {\"name\": \"search-service\", \"status\": \"down\", \"source\": \"b\"},\n    {\"name\": \"auth-service\", \"status\": \"healthy\", \"source\": \"b\"}\n  ],\n  \"total_count\": 6,\n  \"healthy_count\": 4\n}"}
</arguments>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_write</name>
<output>
已写入 /Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260525_140245/intel_e05_basic_synthesis/workspace/merged_status.json (12 行, 471 字节)
</output>
</tool_result>

已成功创建 merged_status.json 文件。文件包含了从两个源文件中提取的所有服务信息，其中：
- services 数组有 6 个服务项（包括重复的 auth-service，因为它出现在两个源中）
- total_count: 6（服务项总数）
- healthy_count: 4（状态为 "healthy" 的服务项数：auth-service(a), notification-service, user-service, auth-service(b)）

文件已按要求格式创建完成。
